role: AnthropicProvider extension holding request shaping: prompt-cache split of the system prompt, tool declarations (only for sends that carry tools; Anthropic server-side web_search replacing the app's Tavily tool), URLRequest construction, and the SSE line reader that rejects a stream cut before message_stop.

units.does: Splits the composed system prompt at the cache marker (ProviderHTTP.splitOnCacheMarker) into stable prefix and variable suffix, then builds system blocks with only the stable one cache-tagged.

Builds Anthropic tools[] for a send that carries tools: nil when tools is empty (the summarizer, fact extraction and voice interjection never get a billed server search). Otherwise custom declarations for every ToolSpec (dropping the app's own web_search when web search is on), the server web_search_20250305 tool (max_uses 3, WebSearchService.excludeDomains blocked) appended when SettingsManager.settingsSnapshot.enableWebSearch, and a 1h ephemeral cache breakpoint on the last declaration.

branches.effect: returns nil (no tools field, no server search)
filters out ToolSpec named "web_search" (Anthropic rejects duplicate names); else all tools kept
appends serverWebSearch(maxUses:3, blockedDomains: excludeDomains); else nothing
returns nil — unreachable: tools is non-empty, and when the app web_search is filtered out the server tool is appended; else last element replaced with cacheTagged copy

units.does: Returns the same ToolDecl with cache_control {type: ephemeral, ttl: 1h}.

branches.effect: rebuilds server web search with cache

units.does: Builds the POST URLRequest: x-api-key, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, anthropic-beta extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11, JSON content-type, SSE accept; body JSON-encoded with .sortedKeys. Throws if encoding fails.

Reads the SSE byte stream line by line: blank line resets the event name, "event:" lines record it, "data:" payloads are passed to handle(); checks task cancellation per line. A stream that ends before message_stop was cut, and throws URLError(.networkConnectionLost) (ProviderStream maps it to a fallbackable .network) instead of passing a truncated reply as complete.

branches.effect: loop until stream ends; throws on network error/cancellation
stores trimmed event name and continues

branches.cond: line does not start with data:

branches.effect: skipped; else handle(eventName:data:) which may throw
